question: By what power and agents is the yoginī named Icchā associated with the realm up to māyā?
premises: The domain extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, relates to the realm up to māyā.
uncertainties: Syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and māyāntaṃ is compressed
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
